findings.title: Authorization check only covers user-owned credentials, not team or delegation credentials
findings.body: The credential lookup uses `userId: user.id` which only matches credentials directly owned by the user. Team credentials (where `userId` may be null or belong to a team member) and delegation credentials cannot have their cache deleted through this endpoint, even by users who have legitimate access. Conversely, if the authorization model should also allow team admins to delete cache for team credentials, this check is insufficient. Consider also checking team membership or using a broader authorization pattern consistent with how other credential operations work in this codebase.

findings.title: No cache invalidation after successful deleteCache mutation
findings.body: After `deleteCacheMutation` succeeds, the component calls `onSuccess?.()` but does not invalidate the `trpc.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars` query. The `onChanged` prop passed from `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper` is an optional external callback that may not trigger a refetch. As a result, the UI will continue showing the stale `cacheUpdatedAt` timestamp until the user manually refreshes or navigates away and back. The `disconnectMutation` correctly invalidates queries in `onSettled`, but `deleteCacheMutation` does not.

findings.title: getCacheStatusByCredentialIds returns expired cache entries
findings.body: The `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` method queries all `CalendarCache` rows matching the given credential IDs without filtering by `expiresAt`. Since cache entries have a TTL (one month per `CACHING_TIME`), expired entries will still be included in the result, causing the UI to display a 'Last updated' timestamp for cache that is no longer being served. This misleads users into thinking active cache exists. The query should include `expiresAt: { gte: new Date() }` in the `where` clause to only report active cache.

findings.title: Plain Error thrown instead of TRPCError results in misleading INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
findings.body: The handler throws `new Error('Credential not found or access denied')` when authorization fails. tRPC wraps unrecognized errors as `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` (500), which is misleading for an authorization failure. This should use `TRPCError` with code `FORBIDDEN` or `NOT_FOUND` so the client receives an appropriate status code and can handle the error correctly.

findings.title: Hardcoded 'en-US' locale in Intl.DateTimeFormat ignores user's locale
findings.body: The date formatting for `cache_last_updated` uses `new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', ...)` which always renders dates in US English format regardless of the user's actual locale. The component already has access to the user's locale via `useLocale()`. The locale should be passed to `Intl.DateTimeFormat` to respect the user's language/region settings.

findings.title: sed -i '' syntax is macOS-only and will fail on Linux
findings.body: The `sed -i '' -E` invocation uses the BSD/macOS syntax for in-place editing. On Linux (GNU sed), this will fail because GNU sed interprets `''` as the backup file extension argument differently. Since this is a repository script that developers on different platforms may use, it should either detect the OS or use a portable alternative (e.g., `sed -i.bak` and then remove the backup, or use a temp file).

findings.title: Dark mode subtitle text uses white instead of a muted color
findings.body: The cache status subtitle (the 'Last updated: ...' line) uses `dark:text-white` which makes it the same color as the title text in dark mode, removing visual hierarchy. It should use a muted color like `dark:text-gray-400` to maintain the distinction between the title and the timestamp, consistent with the light mode styling where the title is `text-gray-900` and the subtitle is `text-gray-500`.
